sloka: यदि दृश्येत सा साध्वी यदि च इह वसेम हि ।स्पृहयेयम् न शक्राय न अयोध्यायै रघूत्तम  ॥४-१-९५॥
transliteration: yadi dṛśyeta sā sādhvī yadi ca iha vasema hi ।spṛhayeyam na śakrāya na ayodhyāyai raghūttama  ॥4-1-95॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmna, the best of the Raghu race, if only that chaste Sita appears, we will stay here. I will not wish for the position of Indra or for Ayodhya.
